summary.one_line: The final bilingual devkit docs match the 37-test import-path hardening and retain the live-game limit.

purpose.evidence: Read all 11 changed Markdown paths. README introduces shared Windows mod-development tools, docs/commands gives operational CLI semantics, AGENTS/CONTRIBUTING govern this standalone devkit, NOTICE records extraction and research provenance, and the six review-contract Markdown files define the requested independent lenses. The docs distinguish the shared devkit from individual predictor/native mod code and do not present it as an official Nival SDK.

structure.evidence: README leads with a clone/setup/first H5U cycle, then map/control commands, path ownership and verification. docs/commands expands command behavior without duplicating the full onboarding sequence. The canonical scripts are under scripts/, the one example recipe under examples/menu-marker/, and tests/ remains the documented canonical test home. Review contracts and pre-push guidance live in their dedicated files; links among README, commands, CONTRIBUTING and the public research diary are coherent.

specificity.evidence: Checked README examples against CLI definitions: mod-dev supports prepare/build/deploy/launch/rollback with --sandbox, --mod and --menu; test-map has --stage; native-probe has launch/status, --map, --control, --army-layout and --native-loader; game_control exposes status/heroes/interact/confirm/finish/results/quit. H5_WORKSPACE resolves mutable state while H5_GAME_DIR selects the source game; scripts/workspace.py and the checked callers implement that split. The docs name exact expected marker `[DEV: menu-marker]` and clarify that deploy is file installation, not visual proof. Final fix removes all three additions of mutable H5_WORKSPACE/.local/native-analysis to sys.path. game_control still loads its neighboring native-probe.py from __file__, while native-probe imports Keystone from the selected Python environment. README names this boundary and updates test count from 34 to 37 in both languages.

reproducibility.evidence: Parent reports 37 devkit Python tests and the existing 8 Node/secret checks passing after the import-path fix. The new inert-shadow test places raising Python modules under an external workspace .local/native-analysis and verifies game_control --help still succeeds without executing them; the older revision failed this differential check. Map startup tests cover one valid descriptor, missing/ambiguous descriptors, traversal, console separators and escaping map filenames. None starts the game. Earlier external-workspace staged map and old bridge checks remain the bounded extraction evidence; no separate live-game acceptance is claimed.

evidence.evidence: The source files support the documented boundaries: scripts/workspace.py separates tool location from H5_WORKSPACE/H5_GAME_DIR; game_launch.map_arguments is reused by mod-dev and native-probe; test-map generator reads templates from the installed data archive and does not reference the object-reference recipe or UniverseTrigger; optional native branches look for external workspace artifacts. NOTICE attributes terrain format and review-contract origin. I did not independently repeat parent's game-archive staging or PowerShell bridge fixture, and did not inspect private game/profile contents. Inspected final diff: game_control.main no longer prepends workspace cache, native-probe removes both cache-path insertions, and README changes only the dependency rule and count. tests/test_workspace.py adds inert shadow modules plus safe/unsafe map_arguments cases. No downloaded game or profile was scanned for this review.

applicability.evidence: README scopes support to Windows 10/11, Python 3.10+ x64 and the pinned Heroes V Universe build; Node 22+ and development requirements are for contributors, not ordinary H5U use. docs/commands states sandbox mode, external optional army-layout/native-loader artifacts, original binary/hash checks and incomplete profile isolation. It warns that addressed mouse messages are not physical RMB proof and that the generic devkit does not bypass the daily movement cap. Optional army-layout still imports Keystone from the installed Python environment and requires external mod artifacts; the common --control path uses canonical adjacent scripts. README does not claim mutable workspace Python modules are trusted dependencies.

translations.evidence: Compared RU and EN README/commands/CONTRIBUTING/AGENTS/NOTICE: both languages describe the same environment variables, separate workspace copy, marker cycle, rollback ownership, map generator count, terminal status semantics, optional native artifacts, test totals and live-validation limits. EN refers to the shared RU PowerShell blocks rather than restating commands with different flags. No material translation contradiction found. Final README RU/EN changes agree on 37 tests, no game launch during tests, and no Python imports from mutable workspace .local/native-analysis.

maintenance.evidence: AGENTS and CONTRIBUTING require updates to README/commands and meaningful tests for tool changes, keep mod-specific C++ outside this repo, and require exact-diff independent reviews before push. The pre-push hook and CI verify actual attestation/checks; docs do not claim cryptographic reviewer identity or server-side branch protection. review:info lists exactly the 11 Markdown paths reviewed here under the configured empty-bootstrap base; no source file was edited by this reviewer. The three new regression tests bring the stated suite to 37 and protect against shadow imports and unsafe map descriptors; the doc remains paired with the source behavior.
